blind.description: A suit of plate armor displayed on a wooden tailor's dummy or armor stand. It features a polished steel breastplate with layered lower abdominal lames, curved shoulder pauldrons, and brown leather fastening straps with small buckles over the shoulders and down the sides. The dummy consists of a wooden torso form mounted atop a turned wooden pedestal post resting on a circular base.
blind.from_above: Shows the flat circular cross-section of the wooden neck aperture between two arched brown leather straps, flanked by rounded shoulder pauldrons extending left and right, with the pointed ridge of the front breastplate protruding downward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.8 to 4 feet tall), and about 2 feet wide across the shoulders.
